description: Defines a template class VectorBuffer implementing a fixed-capacity, vector-like buffer with manual memory management, supporting efficient move and destruction operations for trivially and non-trivially destructible types.

classes.name: VectorBuffer
classes.description: A template class providing a fixed-capacity buffer with manual control over object destruction and movement, optimized for trivially copyable and destructible types.

methods.name: VectorBuffer()
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an empty buffer.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(size_t count)
methods.description: Constructor that allocates memory for 'count' elements.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(VectorBuffer&& other) noexcept
methods.description: Move constructor, transfers ownership of buffer.

methods.name: operator=(VectorBuffer&& other)
methods.description: Move assignment operator, transfers ownership and frees previous buffer.

methods.name: capacity()
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the first element.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns pointer past the last element.

methods.name: DestructRange(T* begin, T* end)
methods.description: Destructs objects in the range if they are non-trivially destructible.

methods.name: MoveRange(T* from_begin, T* from_end, T* to)
methods.description: Moves objects from one range to another, optimized for trivially copyable types.
